lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a staggered 2-3-2 column formation on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper-third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity dorsal light to mid-flank shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of dark, sub-parallel linear striations located on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
